title: Computational and Statistical Hardness of Calibration Distance
abstract: arXiv:2603.18391v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The distance from calibration, introduced by B{\l}asiok, Gopalan, Hu, and Nakkiran (STOC 2023), has recently emerged as a central measure of miscalibration for probabilistic predictors. We study the fundamental problems of computing and estimating this quantity, given either an exact description of the data distribution or only sample access to it.   We give an efficient algorithm that exactly computes the calibration distance when the distribution has a uniform marginal and noiseless labels, which improves the $O(1/\sqrt{|\mathcal{X}|})$ additive approximation of Qiao and Zheng (COLT 2024) for this special case. Perhaps surprisingly, the problem becomes $\mathsf{NP}$-hard when either of the two assumptions is removed. We extend our algorithm to a polynomial-time approximation scheme for the general case. translated_title: 校准距离的计算与统计难度
translated_abstract: 由Błasiok、Gopalan、Hu和Nakkiran（STOC 2023）提出的校准距离，近来已成为衡量概率预测器失准程度的核心指标。我们研究了在给定数据分布的精确描述或仅有数据采样访问的条件下，计算和估计该量的基本问题。当分布具有均匀边际且标签无噪声时，我们给出了一个能精确计算校准距离的高效算法，这改进了Qiao和Zheng（COLT 2024）针对该特殊情形所给出的O(1/√|X|)加性近似。或许令人惊讶的是，当这两个假设中的任意一个被移除时，该问题即变为NP难问题。我们进一步将算法推广为适用于一般情形的多项式时间近似方案（PTAS）。对于估计问题，我们证明了Θ(1/ε³)个样本对于经验校准……（摘要在此处截断）是充分且必要的。
tldr: 该论文提出了在均匀边际和无噪声标签假设下精确计算校准距离的高效算法，证明移除任一假设后问题即变为NP难，并给出了适用于一般情形的PTAS以及估计问题所需的Θ(1/ε³)样本复杂度的紧界。
en_tdlr: This paper gives an efficient algorithm for exactly computing the calibration distance under uniform marginal and noiseless label assumptions, proves the problem becomes NP-hard once either assumption is dropped, and establishes a tight Θ(1/ε³) sample complexity bound for its estimation.
